# drfc fixture (PRD-dream-failure-class-sweep R9)

The passing repaired mission linted by `tests/drfc_ac0N_*.sh` through `tests/drfc_lib.sh`
(copied into a temporary directory with a private HOME, `--last` with `--decisions`). Every
case is this fixture, or one variant under `variants/<name>/` (its `decisions.jsonl` and the
home files that differ), plus one mutation.

- `home/notes/dream-log.md`: two entries of Task `FC-1`. Entry 1 (the FIX round, Route
  `...0001`) lists review r1 and `Mission: drfc-mission edges=... scope=before`; entry 2
  (the re-review, Route `...0003`) lists r1 and r2, every slug `eligible`, and
  `Mission: drfc-mission scope=before,after repairs=notes/missions/drfc-mission.repairs.jsonl`.
- `home/notes/snapshots/{before,after}/`: the two manifests, each beside its own frozen edges
  copy. `before` (r1's manifest) holds PRD a-d, the vision, the matrix and the edges file
  whose header has no external; `after` (r2's) holds a and b repaired, c and d unchanged, the
  widened edges file (external x and edge E4), the frozen external contract copy and the
  repairs file, which `before` does not.
- `home/notes/reviews/r1/`: FIX, sidecar F1 (missing-producer-runner, prds a, consumers b),
  F2 (provenance, prds c) and one advisory row accepting another mission's id (no repair row);
  `r2/`: APPROVE, no sidecar. Each `result.json` carries the verdict lines and `findings=`.
- `home/notes/missions/drfc-mission.repairs.jsonl`: row 1 repaired F1 (changed a, b and the
  edges file; sweep E1, E2) by entry 1's Route session; row 2 repaired F2 (provenance, empty
  changed and sweep) by `...0002`, an earlier author with a launch row and no Route: line.
- `decisions.jsonl`: author rows `...0001`-`...0003`, review rows r1-r3 (`...0004`-`...0006`)
  whose `scope_id` is recorded through `--scope-id`, launch `ts` increasing in line order.
- `variants/`: pre (r2 not yet bound), declined, declined-later, reused-id,
  declined-repaired, three, three-pre, three-fix, reraised-same, reraised-new,
  approve-finding, amended, amended-interrupted, reversed, reversed-declined,
  reversed-accepted, matrix-only, matrix-b.

Generated by the A1723 build's `gen_drfc.py`; the reviews launch after
`SIDECAR_BINDING_SINCE`, so every capture's `findings=` line is compared.
